confidence_notes: Restaurant meal and beer anchors rest on several Coron-specific travel guides and listings with wide, partly dated ranges. The cappuccino rests on one menu aggregator. The cocktail blends an undated average with one happy-hour price. Wine has no direct Coron price and is set at about three times the beer anchor. Beer uses bottled bar and restaurant prices as a proxy for draft. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge; no accommodation searches, booking pages or live listings were checked. Peso-denominated prices were converted at an approximate working rate of about 58 PHP per USD from general knowledge, not a live quote. The FX value is the latest RBA figure found (18 Nov 2026); a 19 Nov figure was not visible.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink use Coron-specific sources, with an El Nido cafe listing as a cross-check for coffee. Wine is derived from the beer relationship. Accommodation is a regional estimate for Palawan island tourism towns from general knowledge, not from a named comparable city's data.
